According to Civiqs, the Republican president holds a strong approval rating in Oklahoma among several demographics, including all poll takers 35 and older, postgraduate-educated individuals, non-Republicans and non-white people.

Oklahoma's party lines mimic that of the national level. Oklahoma Democrats disapprove of Trump at the same rate as the nation; however, Oklahoma Republicans favor him more, at 83%, and Oklahoma Independents disapprove more, 66%. [...] When asked in April 2025, Trump's first three months were rated at 61% approval by Oklahoman polltakers. Now in August 2026, Trump remains at 52% approval in Oklahoma.

results.content: Civiqs, which offers regular updates from its online surveys, pegged approval in Colorado of Trump’s job performance at 31%, with disapproval at 64% on July 30 (4% said they neither approved nor disapproved). [...] Drew Linzer, the director of Civiqs, previously told the USA TODAY Network the firm uses advanced and proprietary modeling to develop results from online surveys of around 200 to 250 registered voters daily across the country. Voters in Colorado and other states are represented in the sample "proportional to the sizes of those states in the US population." Those results are part of the process used in calculating Trump’s approval rating in each state.
